verdict.rationale: Maritime documents first-party webhooks: you subscribe a URL and Maritime POSTs a signed JSON body on every agent lifecycle event, which is a registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive (maritime-docs-3). The evidence covers this core but is thin on detail. Missing for 10: event-type catalog and filtering, retry/delivery-guarantee and signature-verification details, documented subscription via API/CLI endpoints, independent or hands-on corroboration.
